_readme: Data for the interactive 'Find Mass in Canberra' map AND the auto-generated printable poster PDF - both rebuild from this file, so they can never drift apart. TO ADD A CHURCH: copy an object in 'churches', give it a unique 'id', fill in the fields, and save. 'lat'/'lng' come from right-clicking the spot in Google Maps and copying the numbers. 'adoration.access' is one of: 'public' (walk in), 'keyed' (PIN/key required - say how to get it in notes), 'on-request', 'none'. Leave any list empty ([]) if unknown and it is hidden rather than shown blank.
_verification: Mass times change. Confirm each entry against the parish website before each semester and update its 'lastVerified'. The site and the PDF both print a 'confirm with the parish' warning automatically.
notice: Times are checked each semester but parishes do change them - please confirm with the parish before travelling, especially on public holidays.

churches.name: St John the Evangelist Chapel (ANU)
churches.tradition: Campus chapel - ANU Catholic Society & chaplaincy
confession: Friday 5:00-6:00 pm (teaching weeks), or by asking the chaplain

adoration.notes: Open for Society liturgies; contact us to pray here at other times.

churches.accessibility: Step-free entry from Daley Road footpath.
churches.transportFromANU: On campus - 10 minute walk from Kambri along Daley Road.

churches.name: St Christopher's Cathedral
churches.tradition: Cathedral of the Archdiocese of Canberra and Goulburn
churches.accessibility: Wheelchair access via side entrance; accessible parking on Franklin Street.
churches.transportFromANU: Bus toward Manuka from the City interchange (~25 min) or ~10 min drive.

churches.name: St Brigid's
churches.accessibility: Level entry from the car park.
churches.transportFromANU: Easy cycle or walk from north-side residences; light rail + short walk from the City.

churches.name: Sts Peter & Paul (FSSP)
churches.tradition: Traditional Latin Mass - Priestly Fraternity of St Peter
confession: Before, (and if priest available during) Mass
churches.transportFromANU: Society members regularly carpool - ask on our channels. ~15 min drive.

churches.name: St Patrick's
churches.tradition: Historic inner-city church, Canberra Central parish
churches.accessibility: Small step at entrance; assistance available.
churches.transportFromANU: 20 minute walk from Kambri through the City, or any Northbourne Avenue bus.

churches.name: Holy Rosary (Blackfriars)
churches.tradition: Former Dominican parish - the Society's spiritual roots
churches.transportFromANU: Light rail to EPIC + 15 min walk, or ~10 min drive.

churches.name: St Joseph's
confession: Friday: 8:15 am - 9:00 am, Saturday: 5:15 pm - 5:45 pm
churches.transportFromANU: Closest suburban parish to campus - 30 min walk or short cycle from Daley Road.

churches.name: St Benedict's
churches.tradition: South Canberra parish with adoration chapel

adoration.notes: Chapel access is by PIN code - contact the parish office to register.

churches.transportFromANU: ~15 min drive; bus via the City and Kingston.
